text:
maya.cs: Heads up — creating a compact preflight/warmup playbook for mid-enterprise onboarding (TruText). Goal: reduce first-call latency, surface renewal risks early, and capture feedback during enablement. Quick sync pls.

liam.cs: love it. can you list the minimal steps we should run during the first 24h of live?

maya.cs: short checklist (for CS + SE to run before flipping live):
- confirm model pin/version + quantization profile in console
- run prefix pre-warm for top 10 canonical prompts (cache priming)
- run small batch canary at target qps (verify p95 latency)
- enable streaming fallback for >2s generation paths
- capture sample outputs + user satisfaction survey link
- tag account with renewal-risk if usage < 20% of forecast after 7 days

ana.se: adding SE notes: keep batch size conservative for first 48h. recommended: `batch_limit = 8` and `max_latency_ms = 250` for chat-heavy flows. If customer uses long contexts, add a KV-cache priming step.

carl.cs: sample commands I ran during yesterday's pilot (paste to run locally):
```bash
# pre-warm top prompts (curl -> Redwood API)
for p in \"summarize: The document...\" \"rewrite: Friendly tone...\"; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
    -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-3b-quant\",\"input\":\"'$p'\",\"max_tokens\":64}' >/dev/null
done
```

liam.cs: nice. Where do we record the results and the customer feedback?

maya.cs: update the onboarding playbook in the account doc (CRM -> onboarding checklist section) and paste brief results in the account #notes field. For feedback, send the micro-survey after the 2nd live session: link + 3 quick choices (Very happy / Ok / Needs help) + optional free text.

ana.se: also add a perf snapshot in Console -> Deployments -> Snapshot and attach a screenshot to the account doc. p95 + p99 and tokens/sec.

carl.cs: renewal risk rule we used for TruText:
- flag if 7-day active users < 30% forecast OR average session tokens < 40% of expected -> creates ticket for AM to triage.

maya.cs: AM playbook on flag:
1) reach out with 3-day health check email template (include usage tips + invite to office hours)
2) offer a targeted enablement session (30min) focusing on caching and prompt engineering cost wins
3) propose small Dedicated burst if perf unreliable during peak

liam.cs: can we add an automation to prime cache after each deploy? deploy-bot: any suggestions?

deploy-bot: automated warmup hook available. config snippet: `warmup_on_deploy: [\"/prewarm/top-prompts.json\"]` — will POST canonical prompts to pinned model after successful rollout.

maya.cs: perfect. Last bit — feedback capture template to include in survey: \"Was the result useful? (Yes/Somewhat/No)\" + optional comment + checkbox to opt into follow-up. Also log one example output per session for quality monitoring.

liam.cs: i'll draft the 3-day email and the 30min enablement slide deck. maya.cs can you add the playbook to the account doc and tag me + ana.se?

maya.cs: done. added initial checklist + commands and linked snapshot section. tagged you and ana.se. cc @carl.cs for renewal rule reference. :thumbsup:

carl.cs: great work team — let's monitor TruText for the next 10 days and iterate. if we see persistent low usage we'll escalate to sales ops.

maya.cs: closing loop: will post daily mini-updates in this thread for 72h after live.

liam.cs: thanks — appreciate the concise playbook. :rocket:
